class.name: RailVehicleComponentType
class.brief_description: What only a railway vehicle can be asked for.
class.description: Numbered on from the kinds every vehicle has ([constant VehicleComponentType.COMPONENT_TYPE_MAX]), so the two never name the same component: [code]RailVehicleServer.vehicle_component_get(rid, RailVehicleComponentType.COMPONENT_BRAKES)[/code]. A class of its own for the reasons [VehicleComponentType] is one.

constants.constant: The blending of the EP and the electrodynamic brake, [RailVehicleElectroPneumaticDynamicBrake].
The buffers and couplers, [RailVehicleBuffCoupl] - one per end.
What the AI driver is told of the vehicle, [RailVehicleAIHints].
[RailVehicleEnginePowerSource] - what the traction is fed from, and the pantographs.
